rows.label: The Duviri Paradox
rows.note: unlocks Teshin's Cave and the melee rack

groups.activity: clear Isleweaver, or the Duviri Experience / Lone Story Orowyrm

rows.label: Isleweaver completion
rows.note: 15 on Steel Path; needs The Hex quest

rows.label: optional Undercroft side portal
rows.note: 3 each on Steel Path; story-stage portals give nothing

conditions: Pathos Clamps ignore Resource Boosters, Drop Chance Boosters, blessings and Bountiful Harvest: there is no way to multiply them.
bonuses: Isleweaver runs you as your own Warframe with your own Amp, so a bad random Teshin's Cave loadout doesn't matter.
Clearing all three optional Undercroft portals on Steel Path gives 24 clamps (15+3x3) in about 18-20 minutes, the fastest single run.

disclosures.title: which run to pick
disclosures.body: Isleweaver needs only The Hex quest (not the Finale) and is the near-unanimous fastest route since mid-2025. Steel Path Duviri only pays +5 more clamps on the Orowyrm for a much longer run; it's worth it for arcanes and affinity, not clamp rate.

groups.activity: buy the blueprint at the melee rack
conditions: Delivers the Warframe-compatible blueprint to the Foundry in the same purchase that unlocks the Drifter version.
If sold, Cephalon Simaris resells the Warframe blueprint for 100,000 standing.
Stance slot is Madurai, matching Wise Razor; budget a Forma if you don't have the polarity.

disclosures.title: known issue
disclosures.body: The second heavy attack hits once for half the expected damage; still present as of Update 39.1.3 with nothing in later patch notes fixing it.
